POWERFUL GRIP, HOLDS 5 LBS: durable hooks feature high strength grippy backing built to withstand up to 5 lbs; unlike other hooks that break easily, our hooks are designed for long lasting performance
RESIDUE FREE REMOVAL: easily remove from wall without damaging most smooth surfaces; enjoy a mess free experience and a spotless surface after removal
NO TOOLS REQUIRED: installation is quick and easy; simply clean the surface, peel off protective film, and press firmly to desired location; no tools or drilling required
MULTI SURFACE FRIENDLY USE: ideal for a variety of smooth surfaces including metal, plastic, glass, wood, marble, painted walls, and more; please note hooks are not suitable for wallpaper, wall cloth, rough surfaces, or tile with grooves
EXTRA STRIPS INCLUDED FOR REUSE: pack comes with extra strips to use hooks multiple times; can reposition hooks whenever needed with included bonus strips; saves money as no need to purchase additional strips separately; pack includes 2 hooks and 3 strips
